ValidationRule.description: Checking that amount if filled out if the field required to do the amount calculated are not completely filled out. Includes a check if 'price per point' is not blank, to avoid amount being mandatory during lead conversion
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK( Amount ), $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Loyalty_Commercial", OR(ISBLANK( Customer_Base__c ),ISBLANK( Assumed_Tag_Rate_at_Maturity__c ),ISBLANK( Price_Per_Point__c ),ISBLANK( Points_Per__c ), ISBLANK( Average_Spend_Per_Customer__c ), ISBLANK( Probability )) )
